purpose: Second direct/current property-management buyer expansion emphasizing firms that visibly coordinate maintenance, vendors or multi-market rental portfolios.
safety: Inventory seed only. Zillow, Apartments.com and similar portals may be used later for discovery, but this artifact only includes records verified through direct company or current management-portal evidence. No outreach is staged or sent.
